provenance.method: Current GOV.UK Access to Work factsheet and eligibility guidance reviewed for a narrow scheme-scope claim.

title: Access to Work factsheet for customers
citation: Department for Work and Pensions, Access to Work factsheet for customers, GOV.UK, updated 5 May 2026.

contributions.finding: The official scheme guidance describes Access to Work as support for eligible people whose disability or health condition affects work in England, Scotland or Wales, with practical support potentially funded through a grant.
contributions.population_or_context: People in or about to start paid work in England, Scotland or Wales who meet current Access to Work conditions.
contributions.methodology: Authoritative government programme guidance rather than an effectiveness study.

limitations.text: The guidance describes scheme rules and possible support, not whether a particular person will qualify or what support they will receive.
limitations.why_it_matters: A scheme-scope claim must not be read as an individual entitlement decision.
reopening_or_reduction_conditions: Recheck if GOV.UK changes eligibility, geographic scope or support categories.
